H.label: estimated
H.method: Recomputed Chandler §7 Eq.9–10 from the authors' coma-separated Johnson V=22.4 (their own nuclear g/r-to-V conversion via Jester et al. 2005), R=10.10 au, delta=10.01 au, alpha=5.58 deg, assumed G=0.15, A1=3.33, A2=1.87, B1=0.63, B2=1.22. H_V = V - 5 log10(R delta) + 2.5 log10[(1-G)Phi1 + G Phi2], Phi_i=exp[-Ai tan(alpha/2)^Bi]. The paper's reported H_V=11.3 is retained separately; it does not reproduce these inputs.
H.uncertainty: Approximate PSF decomposition, rounded published photometry/geometry and assumed G; systematic uncertainty not quantified. Computation precision is not measurement precision.

H_V.label: estimated
H_V.method: Recomputed Chandler §7 Eq.9–10 from the authors' coma-separated Johnson V=22.4 (their own nuclear g/r-to-V conversion via Jester et al. 2005), R=10.10 au, delta=10.01 au, alpha=5.58 deg, assumed G=0.15, A1=3.33, A2=1.87, B1=0.63, B2=1.22. H_V = V - 5 log10(R delta) + 2.5 log10[(1-G)Phi1 + G Phi2], Phi_i=exp[-Ai tan(alpha/2)^Bi]. The paper's reported H_V=11.3 is retained separately; it does not reproduce these inputs.
H_V.uncertainty: Approximate PSF decomposition, rounded published photometry/geometry and assumed G; systematic uncertainty not quantified. Computation precision is not measurement precision.

reportedH_V.label: estimated
reportedH_V.method: Chandler §7 reports H_V approximately 11.3; this does not reproduce the same section's published V, geometry and Eq.9–10.
reportedH_V.uncertainty: Approximate PSF decomposition; uncertainty not quantified; nucleus colours require coma-free measurements.

reductionInputs.label: estimated
reductionInputs.method: Published rounded inputs to Eq.9–10, including an assumed G; the computation introduces no factor selected by population counts.
